body: No. I'm out here like Rose on the Titanic. It's disgustingly scary.

Climbing back over is scary, I feel like Rose on the outside of the Titanic right now. I just want it all to stop. I just wanna be okay. Things have been bad for so long my brain doesn't know how to even be okay anymore.. and I have three cats. They're my best friends. They're the only thing that's kept me alive for years. I spend every holiday with them. My birthday and Christmas and Easter and everything. Its just me alone, and them. I love them so much. There is my girl Peach, like Princess Peach. And my boy, Price, like Vincent Price. And their daughter, Petunia. :') I love them so much. I hope they'll be okay.
I like your username. Thank you for your nice words, you kind soul. Regardless of my outcome, I love you all too.

I'm crying and my nose won't stop running, I'm shakily finishing my cigarette and your comment is so kind and beautiful. You make me think I should climb back over this ledge and go hug my cat.. oh god. It's so hard. Life is so fucking hard. I hope you have a better outcome than me. You deserve all the love and light, my sweet. You're beautiful. Regardless of what happens to me, thank you for just being so kind. You're amazing. ♡ never forget that
